Xuddi shu sharoitda bu gazning $0.2\text{ mol}$ qismi necha $\text{L}$ hajm egallaydi?
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.s.s1.explain:
1-qadam: Avogadro qonuniga ko'ra gaz hajmi $V$ modda miqdori $n$ ga to'g'ri mutanosib.
2-qadam: $V = n \times V_m = 0.2\text{ mol} \times 24.5\text{ L/mol}$.
3-qadam: Hisoblash $V = 4.90\text{ L}$ natijasini beradi.
